IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx rate for /v2/prompt-route (new prompt-bridge endpoint). 5xx=14% in last 5m (baseline 0.3%). Pager: @alicia-oncall

alicia-oncall: Ack — I'm on it, moving to this channel. Can someone confirm recent canary rollout details?

marco-sre: I'm tailing logs. Lots of `upstream:504` and `kv_cache_miss` during warmup. Errors start ~1832501030 after deploy r2026-03-15-canary-7

priya-eng: Confirmed — I pushed canary at 12:10PT to 20% with feature flag `bridge_v2`. It changes prompt routing and priming behavior. Rolling forward increased requests hitting cold KV cache.

alicia-oncall: OK, plan: immediate FF off, then smoke checks. Toggling now:
```
/featureflag toggle bridge_v2 --env=prod --actor=alicia-oncall
```

featurebot: Feature flag `bridge_v2` toggled OFF by alicia-oncall at 1832501205 :white_check_mark:

marco-sre: Running quick probe against /v2/prompt-route (10 reqs):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/prompt-route -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' -w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\n'
```
Pre-toggle: 6/10 returned 5xx / 504
Post-toggle: 0/10 5xx, all 200

marco-sre: Metrics update — 5xx dropped from 14% -> 0.7% over 3m. Latency stable. :tada:

support-liaison-june: Customer impact summary from Support: ~1.8% of global requests saw errors during the window. Two customers flagged: AcmeCorp (enterprise) and Healthlytics (dedicated) — they saw ~3-5% error spikes. Tickets created: #12345 (AcmeCorp), #12346 (Healthlytics). CS notified.

alicia-oncall: Good catch. Handoff: @nate-oncall takes incident ownership for postmortem and follow-ups. Immediate actions:
• revert canary job and pin rollout to 0%
• create postmortem (owner: nate-oncall)
• add automated rollback threshold: fail if 5xx > 2% for 3m during rollout
• add warmup whitelist / staggered KV priming for new routing

nate-oncall: Ack, taking ownership. I'll open the postmortem and schedule an infra/eng sync. Assigning actions to eng-runtime and eng-sre. ETA for followups: initial postmortem draft in 6h.

marco-sre: Dropping a small log excerpt for root cause:
```
[1832501057] prompt-route | request_id=abcd1234 | upstream_status=504 | kv_cache=miss | model_pool_node=node-17
[1832501061] prompt-route | request_id=efgh5678 | upstream_status=200 | kv_cache=hit | model_pool_node=node-04
```

alicia-oncall: Marking incident: mitigated. Monitoring for 30m then will close. :eyes:

IncidentBot: Incident state -> MITIGATED (mitigation=feature-flag-off). Start:1832501111 Mitigated:1832501220 Owner: nate-oncall

nate-oncall: Will follow up with a canary replan. Thanks team. :heart:
